title: Luminous Harmony
body:
# Luminous Harmony

**Enhance your vanilla QOL.**

## What This Modpack Does

Luminous Harmony is a comprehensive quality-of-life modpack for Minecraft 1.21.8 that enhances your vanilla experience without compromising the core gameplay. This modpack specifically:

- **Improves game performance** with optimized rendering and memory management
- **Enhances visual quality** through better textures, lighting, and atmospheric effects
- **Modernizes the user interface** with quality-of-life improvements and information displays
- **Adds immersive audio** with realistic sound physics and environmental ambience
- **Provides building tools** like schematic support and enhanced camera controls

## Why Download This Modpack

- **Better Performance**: Achieve higher FPS and smoother gameplay compared to vanilla Minecraft
- **Enhanced Visuals**: Experience beautiful graphics while maintaining vanilla aesthetics
- **Quality of Life**: Streamlined inventory management, better UI, and helpful information displays
- **Plug-and-Play**: Pre-configured for optimal balance of performance and features
- **Server Friendly**: Most mods are client-side only, compatible with vanilla servers

## Important Information Before Downloading

- **Requires Fabric Loader 0.17.2** for Minecraft 1.21.8
- **Minimum 4GB RAM** allocation recommended (6GB for optimal performance)
- **80+ mods included** - carefully selected and tested for compatibility
- **Shader pack included** - Builder's QOL Shaders V2.11.0 pre-installed
- **Client-side focused** - works on most multiplayer servers without server-side installation


## Key Features

### 🚀 Performance
Experience significantly higher FPS, faster world loading, and smoother gameplay even in complex environments. The pack is optimized to reduce memory usage and background lag, making Minecraft feel more responsive on a wide range of PCs.

### 🎨 Visual
Enjoy richer visuals with extended render distance, seamless biome transitions, atmospheric effects like falling leaves, and beautiful shader support. Connected textures, improved grass, and enhanced entity models make the world more immersive and vibrant.

### 🎵 Sound
Immerse yourself in a dynamic soundscape with realistic sound propagation, ambient environmental audio, and detailed footsteps. The world feels more alive with enhanced water drips and subtle audio cues.

### 🔧 QOL
Benefit from streamlined inventory management, advanced block and entity information, and easy access to mod configuration. Food and hunger information, improved debug tools, and recipe viewing are all at your fingertips for a smoother experience.

### 🎮 UI
Interact with a modernized interface: preview shulker box contents, see visual status effects, enjoy player heads in chat, and use improved command block and scoreboard UIs. The game automatically reduces FPS when unfocused to save resources.

### 🌟 Play
Build and explore with powerful tools like schematic placement, dynamic lighting, and enhanced camera controls. Social features, custom capes, and third-person improvements make gameplay more enjoyable and customizable.

### 🔍 Tools
Access multi-version server compatibility, quick language switching, advanced search, emoji chat support, and better keybind management for a more flexible and user-friendly experience.

## Technical Specifications

### Requirements
- **Minecraft Version**: 1.21.8 (Java Edition)
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric 0.17.2 or newer
- **Java Version**: Java 21 or newer
- **RAM**: 4GB minimum, 6GB recommended
- **Storage**: ~500MB for modpack files

### Included Content
- **Total Mods**: 80+ carefully selected and tested mods
- **Shader Pack**: Builder's QOL Shaders V2.11.0 (pre-installed)
- **Resource Pack**: Compatible with vanilla and custom resource packs
- **Configuration**: Pre-optimized settings for performance and visual quality

### Dependencies
- Fabric API 0.133.4+1.21.8
- Fabric Language Kotlin 1.13.6+kotlin.2.2.20
- All mod dependencies are included and pre-configured

## Installation

### Prerequisites
- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.8
- Java 21 or newer
- At least 4GB available RAM

### Step-by-Step Installation

1. **Install Fabric Loader**
   - Download Fabric Installer from [fabricmc.net](https://fabricmc.net)
   - Run the installer and select Minecraft 1.21.8
   - Choose Fabric Loader version 0.17.2

2. **Download the Modpack**
   - Download Luminous Harmony from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com)
   - Use a compatible launcher (Prism Launcher, ATLauncher, etc.) or install manually

3. **Configure Memory Allocation**
   - Allocate 4-6GB RAM in your launcher settings
   - For launchers: Edit Instance → Settings → Java → Memory
   - Recommended: 4GB minimum, 6GB optimal

4. **Launch and Enjoy**
   - Start Minecraft with the Fabric profile
   - All mods are pre-configured for optimal performance
   - Shaders are automatically enabled (can be disabled in Video Settings)

## Performance Notes

This modpack is designed to **improve** performance while adding features. Most users will see better FPS compared to vanilla Minecraft, especially with the included performance mods and optimized configurations.

## Shader Support

The modpack comes with **Builder's QOL Shaders V2.11.0** pre-installed, providing beautiful visuals while maintaining good performance. You can easily switch to other Iris-compatible shader packs through the video settings.

## Configuration

Many mods come pre-configured for the best balance of performance and features. You can customize settings through:
- **Mod Menu** - Access individual mod configurations
- **YACL** - Advanced configuration interface
- **In-game settings** - Most features accessible through vanilla options

## Compatibility

### Server Compatibility
- **Vanilla Servers**: ✅ Fully compatible - most mods are client-side only
- **Modded Servers**: ✅ Compatible with servers running same mod versions
- **Fabric Servers**: ✅ Optional server-side installation for enhanced features
- **Bukkit/Spigot/Paper**: ✅ Most features work (client-side rendering and UI improvements)

### Content Compatibility
- **Resource Packs**: ✅ Fully compatible with vanilla and custom resource packs
- **Shader Packs**: ✅ Optimized for Iris shaders (includes Builder's QOL Shaders)
- **Datapacks**: ✅ Compatible with vanilla datapacks
- **Other Modpacks**: ⚠️ Not recommended to mix with other modpacks

### Version Support
- **Minecraft**: 1.21.8 only
- **Fabric Loader**: 0.17.2 or newer
- **Multi-version Servers**: ✅ Via ViaFabricPlus (included mod)

## Credits

Special thanks to all the mod developers who made this pack possible. This modpack is a curated collection of open-source mods, each created by talented developers in the Minecraft community.

---

**Enjoy your enhanced Minecraft experience with Luminous Harmony!**
